title: First Paycheck
for: You just started a job and the stub, the bank, and the fees are all new.

stops.why: The stub is the document everything else on this route refers to, so it comes first.
The gap between what you earned and what landed is the first number people misread.
Most of that gap is withholding, and the W-4 you signed on day one set it.
The account the money lands in has fees of its own, and they depend on the deposit you just set up.
The single most common fee in the first year of working, and the one people say they never understood.
The concept that explains why the overdraft fee happens to some people and not others.
Usually the next thing offered to someone with a new paycheck, so its mechanics come last on this route.
